title: Borrowed Question Value Equality
semantics: Dictionary entries compare in authored order
Intrinsic object members compare in authored order including repeated literal keys
Null, bool, UInt, Int, Float, String, Bytes, Array and Object variants retain identity
Float identity is all 64 bits including signed zero and NaN payloads

work.frontier: Funded first-party paged borrowed pair frames
work.traversal: Linear ordinal traversal; no key search or source copy

lifecycle: Both original issuer+projection bindings checked throughout
No denied turn changes frontier or polls continuation
All page births retain original authority until funded close
Close all frame slots/backing before right and left source alias release
Settled-pair rebind drains borrowed slots and old original aliases under grants while retaining empty frontier pages
Next source pair binds only after a funded final state reset; final close releases retained pages once
